name: e-commerce-website
description: E-Commerce Website Monorepo - Backend, Frontend, and Admin

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:admin
scripts.clean:backend: cd backend && npm run clean || echo 'No clean script in backend'
scripts.clean:frontend: cd frontend && npm run clean || echo 'No clean script in frontend'
scripts.clean:admin: cd admin && npm run clean || echo 'No clean script in admin'
